نبذة

The Nest Salon is an award winning, luxury British owned, ladies only hair, nails, brows and lashes salon located on Jumeirah Beach Road, Umm Suqeim, Dubai. Our expert team specialises in precision cutting, styling, blowdries, balayage, blondes, highlights, colour correction, smoothing treatments, bridal and occasion hair, and premium hair extensions. We are proud Wella Colour Specialists delivering bespoke, high end colour services using advanced techniques.

بناءً على 1,406 مراجعة رائعة من العملاء

Careful listening and a warm, professional approach give The Nest Hair Salon, Jumeirah, its distinctive character, with stylists taking time to understand each client’s wishes. Clients particularly appreciate the thoughtful guidance behind highlights and balayage, as well as precise cuts and blow-dries, leaving with results that feel personal and true to what they had in mind.
